# Example Domain
> Example.com is a reserved domain used for documentation, examples, and illustrative purposes on the web.

This site is intentionally minimal and maintained for use in technical documentation and sample content. It does not provide product documentation, APIs, guides, or blog content.

## Overview
- [Example Domain](https://example.com/): Canonical landing page explaining the domain’s purpose for illustrative use in documents.
- [IANA Example Domains](https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains): Official IANA reference describing reserved example domains including example.com.

## Reference
- [RFC 2606](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2606): Defines reserved top-level DNS names for testing, documentation, and examples.
- [RFC 6761](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6761): Specifies special-use domain names and operational expectations for resolvers and applications.

## Usage Context
- [Example Domain](https://example.com/): Safe placeholder domain commonly used in tutorials, demos, and configuration examples.
- [Example.org](https://example.org/): Companion reserved domain suitable for noncommercial examples and documentation.
- [Example.net](https://example.net/): Companion reserved domain used alongside other example domains in sample materials.

## Policies and Governance
- [IANA Example Domains](https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains): Governance and background for reserved domains managed for documentation purposes.
- [Internet Assigned Numbers Authority](https://www.iana.org/): Organization responsible for protocol parameter registries and related naming resources.

## External Standards
- [IETF Datatracker](https://datatracker.ietf.org/): Source for internet standards documents relevant to reserved and special-use domains.
- [RFC 2606](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2606): Primary standards reference for example domain reservations.
- [RFC 6761](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6761): Additional standards context for handling special-use domain names.
